arguments.name: array
arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

semantics.summary: Sets every element of the specified vector or matrix to the supplied scalar.
side-effects: Mutates every element of the supplied floating-point field.

notes: Chapter 13 restricts these operations to one- and/or two-dimensional fields with floating-point variables.
The addendum equates MAT SET with ARRAYFILL array(),scalar.

support.pending-reason: The repository has a research fixture, but no registered executable conformance test or matrix runtime implementation.
